title: Symmetry of the second derivative of a C^2 map R^n -> R^l
statement: Let n, l be natural numbers and V : R^n -> R^l a C^2 map. Write D^2V(x) for the derivative at x of the map x -> DV(x) into L(R^n, R^l). Then D^2V(x)(v)(w) = D^2V(x)(w)(v) for all x, v, w in R^n.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (V : Rn n → Rn ℓ), ContDiff ℝ 2 V → ∀ x v w : Rn n, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x v w = fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ V) x w v
